title: New-Parent Sleep Debt Estimate
dataSources: Baby feeds (`baby:feed`), baby sleep (`baby:sleep`), diaper changes (`diaper:change`), chore completions (`chore:completion`), allowance ledger (`allowance:ledger`), family calendar (`family:calendar`), growth measurements (`growth:measurement`).
app: Baby-tracking apps (Huckleberry/Baby Daybook exports), chore and allowance boards, shared family calendars, and growth logs — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=baby:sleep event=parent_sleep
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(duration_min) as slept_min by _time
| eval slept_h=round(slept_min/60,1), deficit_h=round(8-slept_h,1)
| sort - _time
description: Estimates how far below a full night's rest the parents fell each day, quantifying the newborn sleep-debt everyone jokes about.
value: Sleep debt affects mood and safety; seeing it plainly helps parents plan naps and share night duties more fairly.
implementation: Log parents' sleep to `index=personal`; schedule daily and estimate the deficit against a target.
visualization: Column chart of daily parent sleep with the deficit to target.
grandmaExplanation: It estimates how much sleep the parents are missing each day, putting real numbers on newborn exhaustion.
